name: Ponnaiyar

sink.name: Near Cuddalore
sink.location: Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, Bay of Bengal

did_you_know: Also called the South Pennar or Thenpennai to distinguish it from the separate (northern) Pennar river of Andhra Pradesh, the Ponnaiyar rises, like the Palar, in Karnataka's Nandi Hills.
It passes near Bangalore before crossing into Tamil Nadu, where the Krishnagiri and Sathanur dams regulate its flow for irrigation.
Despite its length of nearly 500 km, the river's flow is highly erratic and it frequently runs dry for extended stretches of the year.
